import 'frozen_flow_models.dart';

typedef FrozenExistingUserFetcher =
    Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> Function({required String verifiedMobile});
typedef FrozenExistingUserFromVerifyResponse =
    Map<String, dynamic>? Function({required String verifiedMobile});

/// Frozen snapshot of the completed Aadhaar-linked mobile registration path.
///
/// This file is reference-only safe-space code. Do not edit it directly when
/// building a new variation of the flow. Instead, copy the logic into a new
/// working module outside `lib/m1_safe_space/`.
class FrozenAadhaarLinkedMobileFlow {
  const FrozenAadhaarLinkedMobileFlow();

  Future<FrozenExistingAccountResolution> resolve({
    required String verifiedMobile,
    required FrozenExistingUserFetcher
    fetchExistingUserFromEnrollmentProfileDetails,
    required FrozenExistingUserFromVerifyResponse
    existingUserFromVerifyResponse,
  }) async {
    final existingUserFromVerify = existingUserFromVerifyResponse(
      verifiedMobile: verifiedMobile,
    );
    final existingUserFromApi =
        await fetchExistingUserFromEnrollmentProfileDetails(
          verifiedMobile: verifiedMobile,
        ) ??
        existingUserFromVerify;

    return FrozenExistingAccountResolution(existingUser: existingUserFromApi);
  }
}
